resources.string: Product name changer for Galaxy S25 (SM-S931B)
3 · Change Product Name to Galaxy S26
Roll back (remove module, restore Galaxy S25)
Do the steps in order. Nothing is changed before step 3, nothing is active before step 4, and only step 5 can report success.
Install the module from the Magisk app

Root is granted, but the Magisk command-line installer could not be reached from this app. The module ZIP has been saved to
Download/NameS26/NameS26-magisk-module.zip
In the Magisk app: Modules › Install from storage › pick that file › confirm. The installer prints the same compatibility checks. Then reboot and press “Verify result” in NameS26.
The framework now reports Galaxy S26. Open Settings › About phone and check the product name shown there. Does it read “Galaxy S26” with model number SM-S931B/DS unchanged?
Change Product Name to Galaxy S26?

NameS26 will:

• Ask your root manager (Magisk) for root access.
• Re-run the compatibility checks with root.
• Install the bundled, reversible Magisk module names26_product_name.

The module replaces only the value of SEC_FLOATING_FEATURE_SETTINGS_CONFIG_BRAND_NAME in a systemless copy of floating_feature.xml. It does not touch the model number, IMEI, serial number, bootloader or firmware, and it does not write to the system partition.

Nothing changes until you reboot. The app will not report success until the new value is verified after the reboot.
The phone will restart normally. Save your work first. After the restart open NameS26 again and press “Verify result”.
The module will be marked for removal and the original floating_feature.xml is used again after the next reboot. Nothing else is changed.
